_comment: Holds a PAID QMine run at the harness's own approval dialog, with its cost attached.
Claude Code `hooks.json` shape; dsh runs it through @deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code.
This is the only channel that can carry real consent: every argument the MCP server
sees was written by the model, so nothing it checks can tell 'the person asked' from
'the model decided'. A PreToolUse `ask` is held at a dialog that is not model context.
QUOTE ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}. It is a real filesystem path and it may contain spaces —
this checkout's does. Unquoted, the shell split it mid-path, qmine never ran, the hook
emitted nothing, and a decisionless hook FAILS OPEN: dsh falls through to allow and the
paid run starts with no dialog. That is exactly what happened on 2026-09-21.
